title: automate-kms-hsm-tls-rotation-private-installer-helm-terraform
author: Ava Chen
description: Motivation: automate TLS/key rotation and KMS/HSM integration for Private Installer (VPC/on-prem) and provide first-class Helm+Terraform support for customers using Vault/SealedSecrets and PKCS#11 HSMs. This PR adds a cert-rotator component, Terraform modules to manage rotation schedules and KMS keys, Helm chart updates for optional HSM/KMS wiring, migration scripts to backfill cluster annotations, and e2e tests. Summary of changes: - add cert-rotator controller and CronJob templates to Helm chart with RBAC and Prometheus metrics - add optional PKCS11 provider configuration and HSM secret reference pattern to installer values schema - introduce terraform/modules/kms-rotation with example usage and IAM bindings (AWS/GCP) - add terraform/modules/hsm-pkcs11 to wire external HSM credentials and mount paths for private-installer - add migration script scripts/migrate-backfill-rotation-annotations.sh to tag existing clusters so they opt in to scheduled rotation - integrate Vault transit + sealed-secrets patterns: when values.enableVault==true, rotator will push rotated certs into Vault and reconcile SealedSecrets for k8s consumption - add CLI flag to private-installer upgrade flow to run a safe rollout of the rotator (pre-checks and dry-run) - tests: unit tests for rotator reconcile logic, integration harness for Vault/SealedSecrets, and e2e for rotation path against a local kind cluster - docs: docs/upgrade/rotation.md describing rollout, rollback, and troubleshooting - add CI gates: helm-lint, terraform-validate, unit, and e2e (e2e marked flaky and gated by optional job). Rollout plan: feature gated by values.enableRotation; default disabled. Recommend canary enable on a single Dedicated/private cluster followed by gradual rollouts. Migration: running scripts/migrate-backfill-rotation-annotations.sh will safely annotate clusters and create sealed secrets for existing certs. Backwards compatibility: changes are additive and behind feature flags; Helm values schema extends but does not break existing installs. Checklist: - [x] Helm templates and values schema - [x] Terraform modules and examples - [x] Controller requeue/backoff and metrics - [x] Vault+SealedSecrets reconciliation path - [x] Migration script and docs - [x] Unit and integration tests - [x] CI updates and gating
commits: Add cert-rotator controller and helm templates
Add terraform kms rotation module and examples
Add hsm pkcs11 wiring and docs
Migration script to backfill cluster annotations
Add unit and e2e tests for rotation path
Fix lint and terraform validate issues

Priya Singh: Can we gate the HSM PKCS11 config behind a clear validation error if the admin forgets to set mountPath? Otherwise users will get silent failures.
Ava Chen: Added validation to Helm values schema and installer pre-check with a clear error and remediation steps in docs.
Marco Alvarez: e2e flaky in CI at step 'rotate and verify'; re-run fixed it once. Suggest add retries in harness.
Ava Chen: Added retry with exponential backoff in e2e harness; added note to CI about flakiness and marked job optional until infra stabilizes.
release_notes: Adds automated TLS/key rotation support for Private Installer via a new cert-rotator component; Terraform modules for KMS/HSM rotation; Helm chart updates for optional PKCS11 HSM wiring and Vault/SealedSecrets reconciliation. Feature gated behind values.enableRotation; safe rollout/migration documentation included.
